reason: OpenWhisper sets the help card sheet while the card already inherits the caption stylesheet proxy, so WidgetStyleFilter never sees a StyleChange and the @tokens stay unresolved; Qt drops those colour declarations and the description is drawn in the application QLabel colour. OpenWhisper_CPP resolves the sheet through setLocalStyleSheet, as it was written to be, so the description is @text-secondary. Only the description text differs (measured 929 pixels). Reproducing the fault needs a raw setStyleSheet, which lint.style_props forbids.
